parse.title: Knowing Skull
parse.wikitext:
{{Event Header|Event-KnowingSkull.png}} {{E|Knowing Skull}} is a {{QueryLink|Events|shrine:Yes|shrine Event}} found exclusively in [[Act 2]]. It will only appear if the player has at least 13 HP; guaranteeing they can select at least 1 option and leave the event without dying. ==Options== The following options are presented to the player until they decide to leave the event. X is equal to 10% of the player's Max HP (minimum of 6 HP) plus the number of times they have chosen that specific option ({{TS|negative||Lose 6 HP}}, then {{TS|negative||Lose 7 HP}}, then {{TS|negative||Lose 8 HP}}, etc.)

{{Frame|A Pick Me Up?}} {{TS|positive||Get a [[Potion]].}} {{TS|negative||Lose X HP.}} * A random [[Potion]] is immediately added to the player's left-most empty potion slot. * The player is able to select this option even if all their potion slots are full or if they possess {{R|Sozu}}. They still lose HP and this option's HP loss is still increased by 1 even though no potion is obtained. {{Frame|Riches?}} {{TS|positive||Gain 90 [[Gold]].}} {{TS|negative||Lose X HP.}}

{{Frame|Success?}} {{TS|positive||Get a}} {{QueryLink|Cards|color:Colorless|Colorless card}}. {{TS|negative||Lose X HP.}} * A random {{QueryLink|Cards|rarity:Uncommon&color:Colorless|Uncommon Colorless card}} is added to the player's deck. {{Frame|How do I leave?}} {{TS|negative||Lose X HP.}} * This event repeats until this option is chosen. ==Dialogue==
You find yourself in an old, decorated chamber. In the center of the room, a large skull sits atop an ornate pedestal. As you approach, the skull {{TS|green|shake|bursts into flames}} and turns to face you.


{{Frame|Continue}}

"WHAT IS IT YOU SEEK? WHAT IS IT YOU OFFER?"
In sync with its final words, the door behind you {{TS||shake|slams shut.}}


{{Frame|A Pick Me Up?}}
"DRINK UP!"
You obtain a potion.
"ANYTHING ELSE?"
The player is able to choose any of the [[#Options|Options]] again. {{Frame|A Pick Me Up?}} now costs 1 more HP than it did previously.
{{Frame|Riches?}}
"YOU MORTALS NEVER CHANGE. IT IS DONE."
{{TS|gold||Gold}} rains down on you!
"ANYTHING ELSE?"
The player is able to choose any of the [[#Options|Options]] again. {{Frame|Riches?}} now costs 1 more HP than it did previously.
{{Frame|Success?}}
"PERHAPS THIS WILL HELP?" You obtain a card. "ANYTHING ELSE?"
The player is able to choose any of the [[#Options|Options]] again. {{Frame|Success?}} now costs 1 more HP than it did previously.
{{Frame|How do I leave?}}
"BEHIND YOU, MORTAL."
You peek behind the skull. Surely enough, there is a door.
The event ends, and the player is given the option to {{Frame|Leave}}.
==Notes== * {{R|Bloody Idol}} can greatly increase the number of times the player can choose {{Frame|Riches?}} since they will heal 5 HP every time it gives them [[Gold]]. * {{R|Tungsten Rod}} will reduce the HP lost by 1 every time an option is selected. ==Update History== * '''Patch V2.0: The Watcher''' ** Knowing Skull event HP cost increases with each reward taken. * '''Patch V1.1: The Dealer''' ** Knowing Skull event can no longer give you a potion if you have the Sozu relic. * '''Weekly Patch 40: Forethought''' ** Events: Falling, Secret Portal, Knowing Skull, Golden Idol, and Scrap Ooze receive ambient BGM. * '''Weekly Patch 32: Face Trader''' ** Knowing Skull HP cost minimum is set to 6 to prevent infinite gold with Bloody Idol. * '''Weekly Patch 30: Skewer''' ** Knowing Skull event now always asks for 10% of your Max HP instead of a set amount. * '''Weekly Patch 5: Happy Holidays!''' ** Knowing Skull event gets reworked. Die to your greed now. * '''Weekly Patch 3: Balance Balance Balance''' ** Fixed Knowing Skull event options being ordered oddly after choosing the top option twice. {{EventNav}} [[Category:Events]]
